response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and distributed systems expertise with exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, but lacks explicit executive leadership experience in fintech or regulated environments. His background in agentic frameworks and event-driven systems is relevant, though not at the scale or seniority required for a CTO role.
strengths: Hands-on experience with agentic AI infrastructure (e.g., MCP code generators, frameworks at re:cinq).
Proven track record in distributed systems and event-driven architectures (e.g., GISCollective, Dunnhumby).
Diverse technical leadership in scaling tools, open-source projects, and cross-functional collaboration.
concerns: No explicit executive leadership experience (e.g., CTO, VP Engineering) or fintech-specific scale-up roles.
Limited evidence of operating AI systems in regulated/high-stakes environments (e.g., credit risk, compliance).
Agentic AI experience appears more prototypical (e.g., GISCollective) than production-grade for fintech use cases.
